Booked a new event for Fri 16 Oct, 11:00–11:45 America/Chicago, with you, Nadia and Gideon as attendees. I posted the reminder in #strategic-pod as a reply to you. It's longer than the one line you asked for, because it also flags the old booking.

The earlier event, which has only you on it, is still on my calendar. My calendar tools can't delete events, so someone will need to remove it by hand to avoid a double booking.
